title: When a Career Step Back Is Actually a Step Forward

sentences.en: Sometimes we get so used to doing things a certain way that we forget there might be other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 有时我们太习惯于用某种方式做事，以至于忘了可能还有其他选择。

sentences.en: That can most definitely apply to our working lives too.
sentences.zh: 这绝对也适用于我们的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and one of the biggest changes I've made in my career has been exploring ways to earn money beyond traditional one-to-one work.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我职业生涯中做出的最大改变之一，就是探索传统一对一工作之外的赚钱方式。

sentences.en: If that sparks your curiosity, Sophie Foote's free Race to Recurring
sentences.zh: 如果这激发了你的好奇心，苏菲·富特的免费“奔向经常性收入挑战”

sentences.en: Revenue Challenge starts on the 2nd of November.
sentences.zh: 将于11月2日开始。

sentences.en: I'd love you to join us.
sentences.zh: 我很希望你能加入我们。

sentences.en: You'll find my link in the show notes or you can drop me a DM via socials.
sentences.zh: 你可以在节目说明中找到我的链接，或者通过社交媒体给我发私信。

sentences.en: Now on with the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们继续节目。

sentences.en: Would you ever take a pay cut for a job that looked worse on paper?
sentences.zh: 你是否会为了一个纸面上看起来更差的工作而接受减薪？

sentences.en: Because we're taught to think that career progress means more money, a better title and a step up.
sentences.zh: 因为我们被教导认为职业进步意味着更多的钱、更好的头衔和更上一层楼。

sentences.en: But some of the most important moves
sentences.zh: 但我在职业生涯中做出的一些最重要的举动，

sentences.en: I've made in my career have been sideways.
sentences.zh: 其实是横向发展的。

sentences.en: And one of the moves took me entirely away from psychology for almost two years.
sentences.zh: 其中一次变动甚至让我完全脱离了心理学领域近两年。

sentences.en: So how do you know when a move that feels like it might be backwards or possibly sidewards has potential to take you forwards?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你感觉一个变动可能是倒退或横向移动时，你如何知道它是否有潜力带你向前发展？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and this is Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，这里是《心理学其实》。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《心理学其实》。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologiSt. It's really lovely to have you here.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。很高兴你能在这里。

sentences.en: I was inspired to do this episode after seeing a Reddit poSt. And it really made me think about so many aspects of my own
sentences.zh: 在看到一篇Reddit帖子后，我深受启发，决定制作这一集。它真的让我思考了自己职业生涯的许多方面，

sentences.en: career, my own journey, and that of supporting qualified psychologists, even advising people
sentences.zh: 我自己的旅程，以及支持合格心理学家的工作，甚至为那些

sentences.en: outside of psychology roles, when they're considering what they're going to do for work, what they should apply for, whether they should go for interviews.
sentences.zh: 非心理学岗位的人提供建议，当他们考虑工作选择、应该申请什么职位、是否应该去面试时。

sentences.en: And I thought it might be useful to have a conversation about that here with you.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在这里和你讨论这个问题可能会很有用。

sentences.en: So the post in a nutshell was that someone had found themselves in a band five NHS assistant psychologist role, been there for almost 18 months.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，那篇帖子的内容是，有人发现自己处于英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）五级助理心理学家的岗位上，已经待了近18个月。

sentences.en: And now they're sort of at that point where they're like, I think it's time to move on, but I'm not really seeing any other band five roles.
sentences.zh: 现在他们到了那种觉得“是时候离开了，但我真的没看到其他五级岗位”的地步。

sentences.en: I'm seeing maybe lots of band four roles start to come up.
sentences.zh: 我看到可能有很多四级岗位开始出现。

sentences.en: But I'm used to the money.
sentences.zh: 但我已经习惯了现在的收入。

sentences.en: And then I also used to get travel.
sentences.zh: 而且我以前还有差旅费。

sentences.en: So that kind of boosted it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以这在一定程度上增加了收入。

sentences.en: And I'm not really sure what to do.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: So I guess I've got a couple of thoughts around that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我对此有几个想法。

sentences.en: And firstly, it's when you're looking to progress in your career, it might well be that you feel like really, in order to stand out
sentences.zh: 首先，当你寻求职业发展时，你可能真的会觉得，为了在申请表上脱颖而出，

sentences.en: on an application form, I'm probably going to need to get some extra skills, some extra experience, some enhanced level of depth of understanding on what I'm already doing.
sentences.zh: 我可能需要获得一些额外的技能、额外的经验，或者对我正在做的事情有更深层次的理解。

sentences.en: that I think maybe I might have reached the plateau for in my current role.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在目前的工作中，我可能已经达到了瓶颈期。

sentences.en: And believe me, that does happen.
sentences.zh: 相信我，这种情况确实会发生。

sentences.en: And at that point, you might be like, could I do some other bits in this role?
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，你可能会想，我能在这份工作中做些其他事情吗？

sentences.en: Could I speak to my manager?
sentences.zh: 我能和我的经理谈谈吗？

sentences.en: Could I think about doing, I don't know, some service or some audit or taking on a special project that helps me to, to gain more skills and experience?
sentences.zh: 我能考虑做些什么，我不知道，比如一些服务、审计，或者承担一个能帮助我获得更多技能和经验的特殊项目吗？

sentences.en: Maybe I might be able to start supervising a member of staff, maybe I might be able to start putting together a group and then running that in
sentences.zh: 也许我可以开始督导一名员工，也许我可以开始组织一个小组，然后与某位合格的同事、

sentences.en: conjunction with someone who might be qualified or another member of the team or even shadowing some
sentences.zh: 团队中的其他成员合作开展，甚至跟随一些

sentences.en: different kind of different members of the MDT team, if you're in that sort of service, that sort of role,
sentences.zh: 不同类型的多学科团队（MDT）成员进行观察，如果你在那种服务或岗位的话，

sentences.en: so that you can really feel like you are still being shaped, you're still growing, you're still learning,
sentences.zh: 这样你就能真正感觉到自己仍在被塑造、仍在成长、仍在学习，

sentences.en: because I don't think there's anything more stagnating than feeling like you're not really getting anything new.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得没有什么比感觉自己学不到新东西更让人停滞不前的了。

sentences.en: Now, of course, energy wise, sometimes that suits us.
sentences.zh: 当然，从精力上来说，有时那样也适合我们。

sentences.en: So when I was just back from having my second baby, and when I was kind of going through some grief stuff with my dad,
sentences.zh: 所以当我刚生完第二个孩子回来，或者当我经历父亲去世的悲伤时，

sentences.en: then energy wise, I probably wouldn't have been wanting to do things that were a very steep learning curve for me.
sentences.zh: 从精力上讲，我可能不会想做那些对我来说学习曲线非常陡峭的事情。

sentences.en: So a little bit of variety was okay.
sentences.zh: 所以有一点变化是可以的。

sentences.en: But actually, I didn't have the resources personally, at that time, to to be doing more, you might feel different, you might be like, I've got all
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当时我个人没有资源去做更多的事情。你可能会有不同的感受，你可能会觉得：我有这么多

sentences.en: this energy, I've got all this enthusiasm, but I've either reached the plateau for this job, or when I'm
sentences.zh: 精力，我有这么多热情，但我这份工作已经到了瓶颈，或者当我

sentences.en: asking for more roles, when I'm asking for more responsibility, when I'm asking for a little bit of
sentences.zh: 要求更多角色、更多责任、或者在工作中寻求一点

sentences.en: kind of flavour and variety in the work that I'm doing, for whatever reason, that isn't coming to me, you then get to decide, well, what am I going to do about that?
sentences.zh: 新鲜感和多样性时，无论出于什么原因，这些都没有实现。那么你就得决定：好吧，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: Am I going to look elsewhere?
sentences.zh: 我要去别处看看吗？

sentences.en: And of course, none of us are in this to work for free, even though we genuinely care about people.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们没人是为了免费工作而来的，尽管我们真心关心他人。

sentences.en: If we're working in mental health, I would hope that you genuinely move by the distress of others.
sentences.zh: 如果我们从事心理健康工作，我希望你是真心被他人的痛苦所触动。

sentences.en: Because really, I think when we're working in mental health, that is really important, because the money is not is not always amazing, right?
sentences.zh: 因为说实话，我认为当我们从事心理健康工作时，这一点非常重要，因为薪水并不总是那么诱人，对吧？

sentences.en: So you have to have another why.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须有另一个“为什么”。

sentences.en: But of course, if you've got fixed cost bills to pay, maybe your mortgage, your rent, you know, your travel costs, your, you might even
sentences.zh: 但当然，如果你有固定的账单要付，比如抵押贷款、房租，你知道，你的差旅费，你甚至

sentences.en: have dependents that you need to help support, or solely support, then actually dropping down from a,
sentences.zh: 可能有需要抚养或独自供养的家属，那么实际上从一个

sentences.en: from a band five role, or you know, band seven role to band six role to do training.
sentences.zh: 五级岗位，或者你知道，七级岗位降到六级岗位去接受培训，

sentences.en: That is and can be a very big consideration.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个非常重大的考量。

sentences.en: Now with the current cost of living crisis, and of course, if you have been getting travel reimbursements, I don't think we're getting much more than actually the cost of the
sentences.zh: 现在随着当前的生活成本危机，当然，如果你一直有差旅报销，我不认为我们得到的比实际的

sentences.en: fuel at the moment.
sentences.zh: 燃油成本多多少。

sentences.en: So if you're going to be in a base where you are not travelling, you're just going
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在一个不需要出差的基地，你只是去

sentences.en: to your place of work, and then you're going home at the end of the day, then actually, if you're spending
sentences.zh: 你的工作地点，然后一天结束时回家，那么实际上，如果你在

sentences.en: less on fuel, that that kind of travel expense might not feature as much for you.
sentences.zh: 燃油上花的钱少了，那种差旅费对你来说可能就不那么重要了。

sentences.en: It might just be like a psychological norm that you're used to seeing a certain amount of money come in.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是你习惯了看到一定金额收入的心理常态。

sentences.en: But of course, some of that will have been money going out, because you've had to pay for parking costs, you've had to pay for your
sentences.zh: 但当然，其中一些钱本来就是支出，因为你必须支付停车费，你必须支付

sentences.en: fuel for your trips to get out and see your clients.
sentences.zh: 外出见客户的燃油费。

sentences.en: Some of it might be a bit lifestyle as well.
sentences.zh: 其中一些也可能与生活方式有关。

sentences.en: Maybe if you are out and about, you're used to being able to, to work in an agile manner, or work from home sometimes.
sentences.zh: 也许如果你经常外出，你习惯了以灵活的方式工作，或者有时在家工作。

sentences.en: And so some of that might be a little bit of a culture change to you as well.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一些对你来说可能也是一种文化上的改变。

sentences.en: When I was freshly graduated from university, I actually took a completely unrelated role, because I needed to prioritise my own needs above my career needs.
sentences.zh: 我刚从大学毕业时，实际上做了一份完全不相关的工作，因为我需要优先考虑自己的需求，而不是职业需求。

sentences.en: So at that time, I was saving up to go travelling.
sentences.zh: 当时，我正在存钱去旅行。

sentences.en: So my primary concern was being able to be in a role where I could do as many hours as possible at a higher hourly rate than I'd already been on.
sentences.zh: 所以我首要关心的是能够找到一份工作，让我能以比之前更高的时薪工作尽可能多的时间。

sentences.en: So I was a home carer, and I absolutely loved that work.
sentences.zh: 所以我做了一名家庭护理员，我非常热爱那份工作。

sentences.en: But I couldn't suddenly invent more home care clients for the company.
sentences.zh: 但我不能突然为公司变出更多的家庭护理客户。

sentences.en: And so I kind of left the industry all together, and then started doing work as a temp worker in office buildings in Milton Keynes.
sentences.zh: 所以我离开了那个行业，开始在米尔顿凯恩斯的办公楼里做临时工。

sentences.en: And the money for that was higher as an hourly rate.
sentences.zh: 那份工作的时薪更高。

sentences.en: And it also meant longer days.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着工作时间更长。

sentences.en: So I was working nine, I think until 6pm.
sentences.zh: 所以我工作到下午6点。

sentences.en: So long days.
sentences.zh: 所以工作时间很长。

sentences.en: And then there was also the potential to do overtime on a Saturday as well.
sentences.zh: 而且周六还有加班的可能。

sentences.en: So that really did boost my income, which then allowed me to save to be able to have the six months off to go around the world.
sentences.zh: 这确实增加了我的收入，让我能够存钱，从而有六个月的时间去环游世界。

sentences.en: And that was, you know, of priority for me.
sentences.zh: 这对当时的我来说是优先事项。

sentences.en: But it did mean I took almost two years out of what I was doing, until I then found my way back into a relevant role.
sentences.zh: 但这确实意味着我从我所做的事情中抽离了近两年，直到后来我才找到回到相关岗位的路。

sentences.en: Because actually, as soon as I got back from travelling, I went back to doing that temp work, but someone had offered me a permanent job.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，我一从旅行回来，就回去做临时工，但有人给了我一份永久工作。

sentences.en: So I went back to one of the teams that I'd been in.
sentences.zh: 所以我回到了我曾经待过的团队之一。

sentences.en: But I do not consider that wasted time, I consider that personal
sentences.zh: 但我并不认为那是浪费时间，我认为那是个人

sentences.en: enrichment development, personal development for me, and stuff that actually still really helps me
sentences.zh: 充实和发展，对我来说是个人成长，而且在艰难的日子里，回顾我20出头时那些不可思议的回忆，

sentences.en: on tricky days is reflecting on some of those incredible memories that I had when I was in my early 20s.
sentences.zh: 确实对我很有帮助。

sentences.en: I think something else that might be helpful to say is, is my experience of working as,
sentences.zh: 我想还有一点可能有帮助的是，我作为

sentences.en: for example, an assistant psychologist in a team, is that often I felt like I was doing work that was higher up than kind of the band four I was doing.
sentences.zh: 例如团队中的助理心理学家的经验是，我经常觉得我在做比我当时四级岗位更高阶的工作。

sentences.en: And a lot of the roles I was seeing advertised were maybe, you know, suitable for band five people to be doing.
sentences.zh: 而且我看到的很多招聘广告，可能，你知道，适合五级人员去做。

sentences.en: But for whatever reason, they were just band four roles.
sentences.zh: 但无论出于什么原因，它们只是四级岗位。

sentences.en: So please don't think that it's like a demotion if you're applying for a band four role.
sentences.zh: 所以请不要认为如果你申请四级岗位就是降职。

sentences.en: I know, I know, pay wise, it might feel that way.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我知道，从薪水上看，感觉可能是那样。

sentences.en: But similarly, I've worked in band seven roles, that really, I was ready to be an 8A, but there wasn't the budget to be able to,
sentences.zh: 但同样地，我曾在七级岗位工作过，实际上我已经准备好成为8A级了，但没有预算来

sentences.en: to kind of, you know, support a preceptorship shift.
sentences.zh: 支持这种入职培训的晋升。

sentences.en: So it might be that you're, you're in a role at the moment where you are gaining that seniority of experience, if you're looking at
sentences.zh: 所以你可能目前处于一个正在获得资深经验的岗位，如果你看看

sentences.en: your key performance indicators, that you are gaining some of the skills that you would be able to say, well, I am at that level.
sentences.zh: 你的关键绩效指标，你会发现你正在获得一些技能，让你能够说：好吧，我已经达到了那个水平。

sentences.en: But for whatever reason, there isn't the budget there to support that.
sentences.zh: 但无论出于什么原因，没有预算来支持这一点。

sentences.en: So try not to be too led on the bandings is what I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以我想说的是，尽量不要太受职级的影响。

sentences.en: That said, of course, if you find yourself in a role where you're doing things vastly above your spine point, then do discuss that with
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，当然，如果你发现自己所做的事情远远超出了你的职级要求，那么一定要与

sentences.en: your manager and your supervisor to consider whether rebanding might be an option, or whether actually someone else in the team should be doing some of those roles.
sentences.zh: 你的经理和主管讨论，考虑重新定级是否是一个选择，或者实际上团队中的其他人是否应该承担其中一些角色。

sentences.en: I think also it can be helpful to think about the kind of different reasons why we might want to optimise our career.
sentences.zh: 我认为思考我们为什么要优化职业生涯的不同原因也很有帮助。

sentences.en: And broadly speaking, I think they are money, learning, time, wellbeing, relationships, and future options.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我认为它们是金钱、学习、时间、幸福感、人际关系和未来选择。

sentences.en: So for me, it was not a case that I could always keep all six of those kind of ducks in a row, but it's allowing myself to prioritise one or two of those at any given time.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，我不可能总是把这六个方面都处理得完美无缺，但关键是允许自己在任何特定时间优先考虑其中一两个。

sentences.en: And that might suit me for now, but it might not necessarily suit me forever.
sentences.zh: 这可能适合现在的我，但不一定永远适合我。

sentences.en: So it's really empowering myself to make the choice for whatever version of myself is present at this time.
sentences.zh: 所以，真正赋予自己权力，为此时此刻的自己做出选择。

sentences.en: So like I said, if I'd been looking for new roles when I'd just lost my dad, then it might have been that I prioritised a role that was higher paid,
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，如果我刚失去父亲时在找新工作，那么我可能会优先考虑一份薪水更高的工作，

sentences.en: so I could perhaps do fewer days a week, and that was close to home, so that it didn't impact on my relationships and didn't take me too long to get to.
sentences.zh: 这样我每周可以少工作几天，而且离家近，这样就不会影响我的人际关系，也不会花太长时间在路上。

sentences.en: I would love your thoughts on this.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听你对此的想法。

sentences.en: How are you juggling your six components?
sentences.zh: 你是如何平衡这六个要素的？

sentences.en: Do let me know in the comments, whether you're watching on YouTube or on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 无论你是在YouTube还是Spotify上观看，都请在评论区告诉我。

sentences.en: And people have been like, why don't you ever mention Apple Podcasts?
sentences.zh: 人们常问：为什么你从不提Apple Podcasts？

sentences.en: I know lots of you listen on Apple Podcasts as well, but currently there isn't a facility to be able to drop episode
sentences.zh: 我知道你们很多人也在Apple Podcasts上收听，但目前还没有功能可以发布特定剧集的

sentences.en: specific comments, but there is an opportunity for you to rate and review the show.
sentences.zh: 评论，但你们有机会为节目评分和评论。

sentences.en: So if you're listening on your phone, if you go to the show and then scroll down, and then you can click read reviews and write a review, I would be so very grateful.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在手机上收听，进入节目页面向下滚动，点击阅读评论并写下评论，我会非常感激。

sentences.en: I think there can be a pressure to think, I need to know everything, I need to know everything.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们可能会有一种压力，觉得：我需要知道一切，我需要知道一切。

sentences.en: And I think it's that kind of juggle of breadth of experience versus depth of experience.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是经验广度与经验深度之间的权衡。

sentences.en: And so it might just be worth a quick check in with actually, am I putting pressure on myself to know all of these things?
sentences.zh: 所以，检查一下自己是否在给自己施加压力，要求自己掌握所有这些东西，可能是有价值的。

sentences.en: Or could I give myself permission to really, you know, really go deeper on my knowledge and my skills in this area?
sentences.zh: 或者我能否给自己许可，真正地，你知道，在这一领域深入挖掘我的知识和技能？

sentences.en: So to focus on my depth of experience.
sentences.zh: 也就是专注于我的经验深度。

sentences.en: Because believe me, at interview, if you've got depth of experience, when you're asked a question,
sentences.zh: 因为相信我，在面试时，如果你有经验深度，当被问到问题时，

sentences.en: you'll be able to just, you know, give a really lovely answer, rather than then trying to scrabble around for something that seems like it makes sense.
sentences.zh: 你将能够给出一个非常精彩的回答，而不是试图拼凑一些看起来合理的东西。

sentences.en: I know also, when speaking to people about pay, sometimes when you change to a different role, sometimes, especially if you're going to a more
sentences.zh: 我也知道，在谈论薪水时，有时当你换到不同的角色，特别是如果你去了一个更

sentences.en: senior role, there can then be the expectation that any overtime that you do is just part of the job.
sentences.zh: 高级的职位，有时会有一种期望，即你所做的任何加班都只是工作的一部分。

sentences.en: And of course, we don't necessarily want you to be losing money from doing shift allowances or
sentences.zh: 当然，我们不一定希望你因为失去轮班津贴、

sentences.en: shift enhancements or from time and a half that you might have been earning from doing overtime.
sentences.zh: 轮班补贴，或者因为加班而可能赚到的1.5倍工资而损失金钱。

sentences.en: So all of these are important things to consider as well, of course, of any pension implications.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些当然都是需要考虑的重要事项，包括任何养老金的影响。

sentences.en: So we should be thinking about our pensions, even if you were younger.
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该考虑我们的养老金，即使你还年轻。

sentences.en: I wish I'd been savvy enough to start investing when I was in my twenties.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我在二十多岁时就有足够的精明开始投资。

sentences.en: One of my friends was a pension advisor at the time.
sentences.zh: 我的一位朋友当时是养老金顾问。

sentences.en: And I remember just thinking, Oh, how boring, how boring.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时只觉得：哦，真无聊，真无聊。

sentences.en: I wish I'd listened to him because I would be significantly better off than I am now.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我听了他的话，因为我现在会比现在好得多。

sentences.en: If that sounds intriguing to you, please do check out two episodes I did with
sentences.zh: 如果这听起来让你感兴趣，请务必查看我与

sentences.en: Ian Dempsey, who is a financial advisor.
sentences.zh: 财务顾问伊恩·邓普西做的两期节目。

sentences.en: I often think when you're trying to make a decision, you can't go far wrong with opening up a notebook.
sentences.zh: 我常认为，当你试图做决定时，拿出一个笔记本总是没错的。

sentences.en: I like my remarkable notebook, but you might actually prefer pen and paper and scribbling down your answers to some questions.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的Remarkable笔记本，但你可能更喜欢纸笔，并写下你对一些问题的回答。

sentences.en: If you don't like writing, you might find it helpful to drop yourself voice notes, perhaps on WhatsApp.
sentences.zh: 如果你不喜欢写作，你可能会发现给自己发语音笔记很有帮助，比如在WhatsApp上。

sentences.en: That's my favourite place to drop myself memos.
sentences.zh: 那是我给自己留备忘录最喜欢的地方。

sentences.en: And I think some good questions to mull over are these.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一些好的问题值得深思。

sentences.en: What will I genuinely gain from this move?
sentences.zh: 这次变动我将真正获得什么？

sentences.en: What will I genuinely lose from this move?
sentences.zh: 这次变动我将真正失去什么？

sentences.en: Am I still developing where I'm currently working?
sentences.zh: 我在目前的工作中还在成长吗？

sentences.en: What does my life need from my job right now?
sentences.zh: 我的生活现在需要我的工作提供什么？

sentences.en: If nobody could see my job title or my salary, which role will I actually choose?
sentences.zh: 如果没人能看到我的职位头衔或薪水，我会选择哪个角色？

sentences.en: And seeing as this is a pretty good reflective journal exercise, let's drop in one more for you to consider as well.
sentences.zh: 既然这是一个很好的反思日记练习，让我们再加一个供你考虑的问题。

sentences.en: Am I making this move because it genuinely is going to help me or because I'm frightened that my existing experience isn't enough?
sentences.zh: 我做出这个变动是因为它真的能帮助我，还是因为我害怕我现有的经验不够？

sentences.en: If it's the latter, you might find it helpful to talk to someone supportive, a supervisor, a manager, someone else
sentences.zh: 如果是后者，你可能会发现与支持你的人交谈很有帮助，比如主管、经理、或其他

sentences.en: who knows your position and understands the context in which you work.
sentences.zh: 了解你的处境并理解你工作背景的人。

sentences.en: Because of course, we can't know that that is a genuine, genuine opinion that our brain is serving us up.
sentences.zh: 因为当然，我们无法确定那是否是大脑提供给我们的真实、客观的观点。

sentences.en: It might just be a lot of fear that might not necessarily be too much evidence for you to draw that conclusion.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是因为恐惧，未必有足够的证据让你得出那个结论。

sentences.en: So I often think that getting a second opinion from someone that you genuinely trust and has insight into your situation is a really good idea.
sentences.zh: 所以我常认为，从你真正信任且了解你情况的人那里寻求第二意见，是一个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: That said, if your career of choice is psychology and you're striving for the doctorate in clinical psychology, why not check out the aspiring psychologist
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，如果你的职业选择是心理学，并且正在努力攻读临床心理学博士学位，何不看看“有抱负的心理学家”

sentences.en: membership, which you can join from just 30 pounds a month with no minimum term.
sentences.zh: 会员计划呢？每月仅需30英镑起，且没有最低期限要求。

sentences.en: I do also offer therapy and coaching sessions too.
sentences.zh: 我也提供心理咨询和辅导课程。

sentences.en: So even if your career of choice is not psychology, I might still be able to help you to achieve your goals.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使你的职业选择不是心理学，我也许仍然能帮助你实现目标。

sentences.en: So in summary, I think what I'd say is that our careers don't always move in kind of forward increments.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我想说的是，我们的职业生涯并不总是以那种向前递进的方式发展的。

sentences.en: It's not always a neat linear upwards trajectory.
sentences.zh: 它并不总是一条整齐的线性上升轨迹。

sentences.en: Sometimes the right move for you will be sideways.
sentences.zh: 有时，对你来说正确的举动可能是横向发展的。

sentences.en: Sometimes it might pay less if you can afford for that to happen.
sentences.zh: 如果你的经济条件允许，有时薪水少一点也未尝不可。

sentences.en: Sometimes you might feel that the job title doesn't maybe sound that impressive.
sentences.zh: 有时你可能会觉得职位名称听起来没那么令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: And sometimes, like I did, sometimes it might take you away from your ultimate career goal.
sentences.zh: 有时，就像我曾经做的那样，它可能会让你偏离最终的职业目标。

sentences.en: But hopefully you're doing that for a very important reason.
sentences.zh: 但希望你这样做是有非常重要的理由的。

sentences.en: And I think it's with hindsight, when we look back on our journeys, that we sometimes see just how important those sideways or different moves were for us being where
sentences.zh: 我认为，当我们事后回顾自己的旅程时，有时才会发现那些横向或不同的举动，对于我们能够达到

sentences.en: we are right now.
sentences.zh: 现在的成就来说是多么重要。

sentences.en: The sense we made of that, what we learned about ourselves on the way there.
sentences.zh: 我们从中领悟到的意义，以及在实现目标的路上对自己的了解。

sentences.en: I would absolutely love your thoughts on this.
sentences.zh: 我非常想听听你们对此的想法。

sentences.en: Please do drop me a comment on YouTube or on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 请务必在 YouTube 或 Spotify 上给我留言。

sentences.en: And please do follow the show or subscribe to the show wherever you watch or get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 也请在你观看或收听播客的任何平台上关注或订阅本节目。

sentences.en: Did I ever tell you about the time I earned 300 pounds whilst I was at a Pilates class?
sentences.zh: 我有没有告诉过你，我曾在上普拉提课时赚了300英镑的事？

sentences.en: And no, spoiler alert, I wasn't teaching the Pilates.
sentences.zh: 别误会，剧透一下，我当时并不是在教普拉提。

sentences.en: It was money coming into my business whilst I was doing something completely different.
sentences.zh: 那是我在做完全不同的事情时，业务自动产生的收入。

sentences.en: If you've ever wondered how you might create income that isn't directly tied to your time, there's a free challenge starting on the 2nd of November.
sentences.zh: 如果你曾经想过如何创造不直接与时间挂钩的收入，11月2日将开启一项免费挑战。

sentences.en: It's called The Race to Recurring Revenue.
sentences.zh: 它叫“循环收入竞赛”。

sentences.en: It's hosted by Sophie Foot and I'd love you to join through my link so I can support you too.
sentences.zh: 它由 Sophie Foot 主办，我希望你能通过我的链接加入，这样我也能为你提供支持。

sentences.en: The details are in the show notes or you can drop me a DM via socials.
sentences.zh: 详细信息在节目说明中，或者你也可以通过社交媒体给我发私信。

sentences.en: Now on with the show.
sentences.zh: 现在，节目继续。

sentences.en: The Race is open.
sentences.zh: 竞赛已开启。

sentences.en: The Race to Recurring Revenue
sentences.zh: 循环收入竞赛
